svg.text: Sheet 2 rev 2 — Sensing node front end (one board for both nodes; gain and divider by jumpers) + NUCLEO-H743ZI2

rev 2, 2026-10-08: anti-alias filter corrected to a true 4th-order Butterworth (−3 dB 100.6 kHz, −48 dB at 400 kHz) · 1 kΩ + clamp + buffer in front of both channels (replay / HIL inputs) · INA240A2 for ×50 · 47 Ω + 1 nF at each ADC pin · low-Q stage first
U1: current-sense amp, 400 kHz bandwidth, −4…80 V common mode
JP1: INA240 output or SMA i (bench-control DAC replay / HIL output)
R6 / R7: rack 12 V → 20 k / 4.7 k (÷5.3, 2.28 V nominal); feeder 48 V → 100 k / 4.99 k (÷21, 2.28 V nominal); 0.1 % metal film. Full scale 3.3 V = 1.45 × nominal.
same 4th-order 100 kHz Butterworth as the current channel (values identical).
USB FS: event records to the PC
PF13 TRIP — active high → breaker isolated driver (Sheet 3) + LD3 + HIL digital input
PF12 SYNC (in) ← bench control / HIL digital output
PB8 / PB9 CAN-FD → U7 TCAN1042, 120 Ω termination (both nodes)
PE9 role jumper — open (pull-up) = feeder, closed = rack
stage 1 C1 1.5 nF feedback / C2 1.3 nF to ground → Q 0.537, f₀ 103.6 kHz
stage 2 C3 3.9 nF feedback / C4 560 pF to ground → Q 1.319, f₀ 97.9 kHz
overall: −3 dB 100.6 kHz, −2.9 dB at 100 kHz, −48.0 dB at 400 kHz (LTspice D / ngspice)
rev 1 had 2.2 / 1 nF and 0.68 / 1.5 nF: Q 0.74 / 0.34, −3 dB at 52.5 kHz, −45 dB at 400 kHz
values are the design start; the built filter's step response is measured on the scope
and that response (not MODEL.md's 0.4·f_s) goes into the bench / HIL dataset synthesis.
Input network (new): 1 kΩ + BAT54S clamp to 3.3 V / GND + unity buffer in front of the
filter on both channels, before the jumper, so the INA240, the DAC replay and a HIL output all
see the same protection and the filter always sees the buffer's low impedance (f₀ unchanged).
HIL 0–10 V outputs: 3:1 pad (20 kΩ / 10 kΩ) on the HIL adapter panel ahead of the SMA; a ±10 V
fault through the clamp pushes ≈ 7 mA into the 3.3 V rail — first line of protection is
saturating the HIL outputs to 0–10 V in the model.
Full scale and resolution: rack 13 × rated = 2.6 V (1 mΩ × 130 A × 20); rated = 200 mV ≈ 4 000 LSB.
Feeder 2 × rated = 2.5 V (10 mΩ × 5 A × 50); rated = 1.25 V ≈ 24 800 LSB. ADC pin: 47 Ω + 1 nF
(H7 R_AIN at 16-bit / 8.5-cycle sampling). Clamps D1–D4 protect the pins during a fault transient.
Power: 3.3 V from the Nucleo; analog rail through a ferrite bead with 10 µF + 100 nF at every OPA2350 (6 duals: U2–U6, one spare).
Deliberately NOT on the bench node: galvanic isolation (common ground), the external 14-bit SAR ADC — product items.
Pins per firmware/node/board.h (PA3, PC0, PF12–15, PE9, PD8/PD9); change board.h if the header pins differ.
INA240 gain options: A1 = 20, A2 = 50, A3 = 100, A4 = 200 V/V — the feeder node uses A2 (the rev-1 parts list said A3).
